caption: The drawing depicts a mantel clock with a rounded top and a rectangular base, rendered in shades of brown to suggest a wooden texture. The body of the clock is a medium to dark brown, with visible wood grain patterns. The clock face is circular, positioned centrally on the front of the wooden body, and is a light beige or off-white color. The clock face is bordered by a thin, darker ring. Roman numerals are used for the hours, and they are colored black. The minute and hour markings surround the numerals, also in black. The clock has two black hands, with the hour hand pointing at 11 and the minute hand pointing at 3. The drawing is framed within a thin, single red-brown line, and there is a small artist’s inscription in the bottom right corner of the border. The background of the drawing is a solid, light beige color.
title: Shelf Clock or Mantel Clock
